description: Restore trashed content, revert to an earlier content version, move content to another brand, revoke public review links, manage author profiles, run the internal team approval workflow (submit_approval, approve_team, reject_team, reset_review), or add/fetch feedback on campaigns or specific assets (add_feedback, get_review_feedback).

assetId.description: Optional ContentAsset UUID to scope submit_approval, approve_team, reject_team, reset_review, or add_feedback to a single platform asset

limit.description: Max feedback items to return for get_review_feedback

message.description: Feedback comment text for add_feedback (or reason for approve_team/reject_team)

publishNow.description: Optional flag for approve_team to immediately release pending scheduled posts

reason.description: Optional approval/rejection note for approve_team or reject_team

scheduledAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp override for approve_team when releasing pending scheduled posts

status.description: Optional feedback status (APPROVED | CHANGES_REQUESTED | COMMENT) used as filter in get_review_feedback or decision status in add_feedback (defaults to COMMENT)

name: wordflux_manage_content_extras
